subject: Usage fidelity review + short-term surge & capacity bridge
messages:
From: Lucy Park <lucy@studioai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@cloudops.io>, procure@studioai.com
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 usage recap + request for short-term surge credit

Hi Grace,

Quick note after our internal ops review — StudioAI expects a 2.5x token surge for June (marketing pilot + higher inference depth on certain models). We're on track to exceed our committed run-rate by mid-month unless we glue a short-term plan together.

Can you share: a) a short ROI recap (token spend vs latency improvements) for the last quarter, b) a proposal for a three-month surge/bridge (pricing + any burst credit), and c) anything we should know about performance impact if we move a subset of traffic to a quantized variant?

Procurement (procure@studioai.com) asked me to get a firm-ish number so they can start a PO conversation. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week.

Thanks —
Lucy
Head of Product, StudioAI

P.S. Attaching our rough forecast (we'll send a sanitized token export separately).

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Park <lucy@studioai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 usage recap + request for short-term surge credit

Lucy — thanks for the heads up. Appreciate the forecast.

I've started a quick pull of your usage and performance metrics for Apr–May. Preliminary notes:
- Monthly token spend grew ~48% MoM for the smart-rewrite pipeline.
- Average p95 generation latency increased from 310ms to 380ms when sequence lengths expanded beyond 1,024 tokens.
- There are clear opportunities to reduce per-token cost by routing non-real-time batch workloads to a quantized variant (we've seen ~30% cost down with ~2–3% quality delta in similar customers).

I'll attach the cleaned token export and a latency PDF in a follow-up (sensitive lines removed). For next steps I propose:
1) Short ROI slide: delta spend vs latency gains for the last quarter (I can draft).
2) A 3-month bridge: suggest a burst credit to cover +30% of projected overage for June–Aug, with a 10% premium on rates for the additional committed capacity if they want predictable pricing.
3) Pilot a quantized variant on a slice of the rewrite pipeline (10–15% traffic) to measure quality impact before broader migration.

Ben — looping you for pricing and any contractual constraints.
Marissa — can you own monitoring/alerts if we enable prefix caching and route a slice to quantized? We'll want playbooks.

Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0182

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Lucy Park <lucy@studioai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 usage recap + request for short-term surge credit

Lucy / Grace — thanks. I put together three quick pricing scenarios and attached a spreadsheet (proposed_pricing_scenarios.xlsx). TL;DR:
- Option A (Flex Burst): No upfront commit; pay on overage at 1.6x public rate; 10% burst credit applied to June only.
- Option B (3-month Bridge): Temporary committed uplift for Jun–Aug with 15% discounted unit price on the uplifted tokens vs public list and a one-time $5k surge credit amortized over the quarter.
- Option C (Commit + Pilot): Add 25% to current commit for 12 months, pilot quantized route (we'll set automatic fallback to full model), plus tiered true-up.

I recommend Option B as the least operational friction for StudioAI while giving them predictable economics.

Procurement note: We can accept a short PO that references deal S-2025-1198 and a simple addendum for the bridge term. Grace — can you confirm the exact uplift token band you'd like priced?

Ben Carter
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0133

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@cloudops.io>
To: procure@studioai.com, Lucy Park <lucy@studioai.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 usage recap + request for short-term surge credit

Quick procurement note (cc'ing Lucy): StudioAI prefers the shortest contractual exposure possible. We'll accept a 3-month addendum but want monthly invoicing and a monthly true-up clause (reconcile actual vs committed at month end). Also need confirmation that audit logs and latency SLOs are not changed by this bridge.

From: procure@studioai.com

We'll sign a PO once Redwood confirms the monthly true-up and the burst credit treatment in writing.

Thanks,
Daniel
Head of Cloud Ops, StudioAI (external procurement advisor)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucy Park <lucy@studioai.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 usage recap + request for short-term surge credit

Grace/Ben — internal ops & CS notes to close this out quickly:
- I ran the routing impact simulation on StudioAI's recent window. Routing 12% of rewrite throughput to the quantized variant reduced token spend estimate by 24% with an expected quality delta of ~1.8% on BLEU-like metrics for that workload.
- We can instrument a short A/B with live monitoring; I'll prepare dashboards and alert playbooks.
- For the billing ask: monthly true-up is doable. For the burst credit treatment: propose we structure the $5k credit as a billing credit applied evenly across three invoices if Option B chosen.

Action items before PO:
1) Grace: confirm uplift token band for pricing (StudioAI's forecast attached shows ~2.3M additional tokens for June).
2) Ben: finalize Option B line items and the addendum language for monthly true-up and billing-credit amortization.
3) Marissa: I'll publish dashboards and attach SLO notes showing no change to latency SLOs for production traffic (quantized route will be opt-in and routed traffic will have fallback).

If we can close these three items by EOD Wed 6/4, procurement can issue the PO on Thurs.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0170
